DevopsTestProvider.name: DevopsTestProvider
DevopsTestProvider.description: Stores the configuration and metadata of both internal and external testing providers integrated with the DevOps framework. It serves as a central registry of supported test providers, maintaining provider-specific information such as implementation identifiers, language settings, URLs, and integration details required to connect and manage external testing systems within DevOps processes.

ApexClassIdentifier.description: Stores the identifier of the Apex class used to implement the test provider integration.

Description.description: Stores additional details or notes about the test provider.

DeveloperName.description: Stores the unique developer name used to identify the test provider.

Icon.description: Stores icon information or metadata associated with the test provider.

Language.description: Specifies the localized language and regional locale code used for the test execution context or report generation. This ensures that any logs, system-generated error messages, or feedback from the DevOps pipeline stage are parsed and presented in the correct linguistic format.

LearnMoreUrl.description: Stores a URL that provides additional information or documentation about the test provider.

MasterLabel.description: Stores the display label of the test provider.

NamespacePrefix.description: Stores the namespace prefix associated with the test provider package, if applicable.

TestProviderUrl.description: Stores the URL used to access or integrate with the external test provider.
